metaDescription: Scrape Product Hunt leaderboards (daily to yearly) with ranks and upvotes, company websites, makers and hunters, reviews, comments and topics.
intro: Get Product Hunt launches from daily, weekly, monthly or yearly leaderboards with rank and upvotes, company website, makers and hunters, full reviews with star ratings, comments, topics and media. Search by keyword, topic or link.
useCases: Build lead lists of newly launched startups
Study what top-ranked launches have in common

faq.q: Does Product Hunt have an API?
faq.a: Yes, a GraphQL API with a token, rate limits and no commercial use without permission. This actor needs no token and returns leaderboards, launches, reviews and comments as JSON or CSV.
Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly, plus search by keyword or topic and single product links.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Product Hunt API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Product Hunt has an official GraphQL API that needs a token, has rate limits and does not allow commercial use without permission. This actor reads the public leaderboards, search and product pages.
